1	Instruction packet bootstrap: part 6/6

3	## Filename signals
4	
5	Authoritative: any match activates the profile. Filename matches short-circuit content inspection for the matched file.
6	
7	- `SKILL.md` (exact) — the canonical skill entry point. Any file literally named `SKILL.md` activates the profile.
8	- **Skill-root adjacency rule:** any file whose nearest ancestor directory contains a `SKILL.md`. Walk upward from the file's parent directory toward the repo root; stop at the first directory containing a `SKILL.md`. If found, the file is part of that skill and the profile activates. This covers:
9	  - Direct siblings (e.g., `skills/review-code/plan-mode.md` where `skills/review-code/SKILL.md` exists)
10	  - Resource subdirectories (e.g., `skills/my-skill/references/guide.md`, `skills/my-skill/scripts/helper.py`)
11	  - Eval fixtures (e.g., `skills/my-skill/evals/test-1/eval.json`)
12	
13	The binding constraint is nearest-ancestor `SKILL.md`, following the same ancestor-walk pattern as the Helm template rule in the k8s profile (files under `templates/` activate when the parent contains `Chart.yaml`).
14	
15	**Scoping:** the walk stops at the *first* directory containing `SKILL.md`. A `SKILL.md` at the repo root does NOT claim every file in the repository — files in subdirectories that have their own `SKILL.md` are scoped to that nearer ancestor. Files outside any `SKILL.md`-containing ancestor do not activate.
16	
17	**Edge cases and non-triggers:**
18	- Test-fixture `SKILL.md` files inside `evals/test-files/` are legitimate detection targets — they *are* skill files. The ancestor walk scopes them correctly.
19	- Generic markdown outside a skill root (`docs/design.md`, `README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`) does NOT activate, regardless of content or frontmatter.
20	- Agent definitions (`agents/*.md`) with skill-like `name:` / `description:` frontmatter do NOT activate unless they sit under a `SKILL.md`-rooted ancestor.
21	
22	## Content signals
23	
24	_None._ Skill detection is entirely file-location-based. Content inspection cannot reliably distinguish skill instructions from other markdown.
25	
26	## Design signals
27	
28	display_name: Agent Skills
29	tokens:
30	  - skill
31	  - SKILL.md
32	  - agent skill
33	  - slash command
34	  - skill description
35	  - skill trigger
36	
37	END SOURCE
38	
39	END PACKET PART 6/6
